message:
We've all been there—you're in the middle of a family outing, your phone is buzzing with messages, and suddenly it drops to 5% battery. Panic starts to set in as you think of all the important information you might need—maps, contacts, even that recipe for dinner later! 

This little moment reminded us how crucial it is to have a backup plan. We’ve started keeping a printed list of important contacts and essential details tucked into our go-bags, just in case our tech decides to take a break at the worst possible moment. 

It’s just a small step, but it gives us peace of mind knowing we’re prepared for those unexpected hiccups. Have you thought about what you'd do if your phone suddenly died while you needed it most? 🤔
